subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): add escapeHtml seam and collapse six copies

question: Should OpenClaw accept `escapeHtml` as a supported third-party Plugin SDK contract rather than keep this helper bundled-internal?
rationale: The helper has six bundled consumers, but every new Plugin SDK callable export creates a lasting compatibility and security-documentation commitment.

options.title: Accept a narrow public helper
options.body: Keep the export, narrow its supported sink contract, and require real generated-output proof before merge.

options.title: Keep it bundled-internal
options.body: Share the implementation through a bundled-only internal facade without expanding the third-party SDK.

options.title: Pause the consolidation
options.body: Defer the shared seam until maintainers want to own the permanent public contract.

recommendation.title: Accept a narrow public helper
recommendation.body: Keep the export, narrow its supported sink contract, and require real generated-output proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete sponsors the linked direction and is the strongest available owner for deciding whether this becomes public SDK surface.
